title: 911 Dispatch Audio: Mich. State Univ. Active Shooter (Full Length Archive)
description:
Dispatch audio taken from East Lansing/MSU shared channel Talk Group 139 on February 13, 2023. Sharing this as the original source of dispatch audio.

MSU 911 dispatch audio, first 6 min:
-Shooting call for Berkey hall
-Shooting in rm 114 & 135; 1 shot in head, students jumping out window
-Need "multiple, multiple ambulances"
-Officer sees shots fired to the west, gives suspect desc
-Suspect enters The Union; 1 shot in head

There are two crime scenes involving victims - Berkey Hall and The Union. These buildings are adjacent to each other. 

Contrary to what is trending on social media, there is only one shooter.
